description: YOLO (Yesterday's Objects, Lasting Outcomes) is inspired by the legacy of NASA's space exploration missions. We aim to bring attention to the spacecraft, rovers, landers, and scientific instruments left behind on the Moon, Mars, and beyond. Through research, technology, and creative storytelling, we seek to make their histories, discoveries, and scientific contributions engaging and accessible to the next generation of space enthusiasts. Because a mission ending doesn't mean its story ends.
